name: EPH receptor A7
pathways: negative regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: EPHA7 encodes ephrin type-A receptor 7. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and chemorepellent activity. It participates in negative regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and phosphorylation.
